summary: Missoula County, MT 30-foot pole L-4 tower built in 1936 on the Lolo National Forest and destroyed in 1953 per firelookout.com; the FFLA list agrees it is gone.

facts.design: 30-foot pole tower of the L-4 type
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1953 per firelookout.com; FFLA status Gone; beyond that status, no source describes what remains at the site

evidence.supports: built 1936 as a 30-foot pole L-4 tower; destroyed 1953
agency named as Lolo National Forest
FFLA lists the site as a tower with status gone, at coordinates 46.92695, -114.32064

notes_for_editor: Both sources agree the tower is gone. The 1936 and 1953 dates and the elevation come from firelookout.com alone. The page's 30 feet is the tower height; it is not stated whether that is to the cab floor, so height_m 9.1 may be off. A Facebook post about Lolo National Forest fire towers manned in 1953 appeared in search, but it does not name this tower, so it is not used. No staffing or fire information found.
